**Adoption**
Resolution 2756 (2024) adopted 31 October 2024 (MAIN). 12 votes for, 0 against, 2 abstentions (Mozambique, Russia), 1 non-participating (Algeria).

**Amendments**
Algeria's S/2024/797 (nine-year absence note) failed 6–0–9 (AMEND). S/2024/798 (MINURSO monitoring expansion) failed 5–0–10 (AMEND).

**Algeria**
Non-participating in final vote (MAIN). National draft rejected Council's failure to incorporate monitoring (DZ-DRAFT).

**Switzerland**
Voted for Resolution 2756 (CH-B). Abstained on MINURSO monitoring amendment (CH-A) to preserve consensus; did not vote on nine-year absence note (AMEND).

**Authority**
Mandate extended to 31 October 2025 (TEXT). OHCHR access urged but not mandated (TEXT). Adopted text did not add monitoring functions (TEXT).
